episodes.title: There Is No Line
episodes.summary: An entitled young writer and a waning comedy legend must put aside their differences to save their careers.

episodes.title: Primm
episodes.summary: With her prime performance slots hanging in the balance, Deborah reluctantly begins working with Ava, testing their initial compatibility with a highly unconventional road trip. As they encounter unexpected bumps, Ava learns a messy lesson in resilience.

episodes.title: A Gig's a Gig
episodes.summary: After being enlisted for the arduous task of archiving material from Deborah's entire career, Ava gains invaluable insight into her employer. An unexpected package fuels longstanding tensions between Deborah and an estranged family member.

episodes.title: D'Jewelry
episodes.summary: At DJ's jewelry expo, Ava comes to better understand Deborah and DJ's complicated mother-daughter relationship. Deborah receives an unexpected piece of ammunition against Marty.

episodes.title: Falling
episodes.summary: Deborah blackmails Marty. Ava has a wild night to remember in Vegas that puts everything in perspective.

episodes.title: New Eyes
episodes.summary: While Deborah recovers from surgery, she and Ava have a unique bonding experience when Deborah dispels a major misperception about her past.

episodes.title: Tunnel of Love
episodes.summary: DJ's birthday party becomes a surprise dual function. Meanwhile, Deborah and Marty reconnect.

episodes.title: 1.69 Million
episodes.summary: With a little encouragement from Ava, Deborah's unpolished set sparks a career-defining moment.

episodes.title: Interview
episodes.summary: Ava pursues an opportunity while Deborah nervously anticipates her final show.

episodes.title: I Think She Will
episodes.summary: As her final performance at the Palmetto approaches, Deborah must decide whether to put it all on the line.

episodes.title: There Will Be Blood
episodes.summary: Deborah eagerly anticipates trying out her new material on the road, while Ava dreads the fallout of an explosive email.

episodes.title: Quid Pro Quo
episodes.summary: Deborah embraces tour life; Ava grapples with the value of honesty; Jimmy learns the harsh realities of Hollywood dealmaking.

episodes.title: Trust the Process
episodes.summary: Deborah continues to workshop her material on the road, as Ava adapts to a new lifestyle. Marcus is overwhelmed by life without Wilson.

episodes.title: The Captain's Wife
episodes.summary: While Deb struggles to connect with her audience on a cruise, Ava finds herself an unexpected hit.

episodes.title: Retired
episodes.summary: An impromptu detour finds Deborah reckoning with long-held guilt while reconnecting with a former comedian friend.

episodes.title: The Click
episodes.summary: A girls' night out finds Ava attempting to connect with her mother – and Deborah embracing some unexpected company.

episodes.title: On the Market
episodes.summary: Deborah and her team head to LA to pitch her new set as a comedy special.

episodes.title: The One, The Only
episodes.summary: Deborah prepares to take the stage for her taping as Ava deals with a new opportunity.

episodes.title: Just for Laughs
episodes.summary: As Deborah prepares to accept an award in Montreal, Ava does her best to avoid her former employer.

episodes.title: Better Late
episodes.summary: Deborah and Ava struggle to stay out of one another's orbits – especially when Deborah lands an unexpected opportunity.

episodes.title: The Roast of Deborah Vance
episodes.summary: After learning there's a Late Night vacancy, Deborah snaps into high gear to make sure everything -- and everyone -- is perfect for her upcoming roast. While Ava consults Kiki about boundary-setting, DJ invites Deborah to speak at her NA meeting.

episodes.title: Join the Club
episodes.summary: Deborah is invited to hang with some of her favorite comedians, Jimmy finally lands a general meeting with Winnie, and Marcus recruits Ava for trivia.

episodes.title: One Day
episodes.summary: As Deborah contends with writer's block and Ava with a broken heart, the pair decide to clear their heads in the woods.

episodes.title: Par for the Course
episodes.summary: Deborah participates in a golf tournament to get face time with the cable affiliates who could decide her future.

episodes.title: The Deborah Vance Christmas Spectacular
episodes.summary: Deborah braces for Kathy's attendance at her Christmas party, while Jimmy and Kayla refuse to call it quits on the comedian's Late Night dreams.

episodes.title: Yes, And
episodes.summary: A calendar mix-up finds Deborah double booked ... just as an unfortunate supercut of her most problematic early jokes starts circulating.

episodes.title: Bulletproof
episodes.summary: As Deborah works to perfect her second run at Late Night, Ava receives a dream offer, and Jimmy and Kayla seek to grow their company.

episodes.title: Big, Brave Girl
episodes.summary: Furious with Ava for forcing her way into the head writer position, Deborah stops at nothing to get her removed from Late Night. As Ava attempts to beat her boss at her own game, Marcus prepares for a difficult conversation with Deborah.

episodes.title: Cover Girls
episodes.summary: As Deborah and Ava's feud threatens the future of their show, Jimmy and Kayla have their own struggles.

episodes.title: What Happens in Vegas
episodes.summary: Though reeling from their meeting with Winnie, Deborah and Ava continue to clash over creative control on their writers' "retreat" in Vegas – all while pressure mounts to craft the perfect opening sketch.

episodes.title: I Love LA
episodes.summary: During a dress rehearsal, Deborah experiences a shocking "first" that stands to throw her off her game. Meanwhile, Ava makes a connection at a sex shop. Then, Deborah takes the stage for her first episode of Late Night.

episodes.title: Clickable Face
episodes.summary: Following a focus group, Deborah goes above and beyond to reach a coveted demo, while Ava tries to maintain the show's integrity.

episodes.title: Mrs. Table
episodes.summary: Deborah receives the "Courage in Comedy" award, while Ava reaches a breaking point.

episodes.title: D'christening
episodes.summary: Deborah and Ava return to Vegas for DJ's son's christening. Jimmy and Kayla have their hands full with Dance Mom.

episodes.title: Witch of the Week
episodes.summary: Deborah pitches a new approach for the show. Nina arrives with a plan for Ava's future. Jimmy struggles to keep up, while Kayla fields an offer.

episodes.title: A Slippery Slope
episodes.summary: When Late Night is forced to censor an interview, Deborah and Ava get inadvertently embroiled in controversy. Meanwhile, Jimmy hits rock bottom and Kayla gains clarity on where she belongs.

episodes.title: Heaven
episodes.summary: Deborah deals with a difficult contract negotiation.

episodes.title: EGOT
episodes.summary: After returning from Singapore to a career further smeared by Bob Lipka, Deborah decides to shift the narrative and focus on achieving EGOT status.

episodes.title: Number One Fan
episodes.summary: Deborah rallies her fanbase to help secure Madison Square Garden for her next stand-up show. Meanwhile, Jimmy pitches an idol, and Ava meets a fan.

episodes.title: No New Tricks
episodes.summary: Deborah hits it off with the Palmetto's new artist in residence. Marcus sets out to save a historic casino, and Marty has uninvited wedding guests.

episodes.title: Who's Making Dinner?
episodes.summary: Ava finds inspiration at a 50th anniversary event for Who's Making Dinner?, while Deborah is reminded of painful memories.

episodes.title: D'Amazing Race
episodes.summary: Deborah fulfills a lifelong promise to DJ, while Ava attempts to secure the rights for her Who's Making Dinner? reboot.

episodes.title: QuikScribbl
episodes.summary: With The Diva heading way over budget, Deborah meets with an investor, while Jimmy and Kayla attempt to land a comic in residence.

episodes.title: Montecito
episodes.summary: Determined to wear an esteemed suit for her MSG show, Deborah finds herself on an unexpected couple's weekend in Montecito.

episodes.title: The Cube
episodes.summary: Deborah's show hits another snag when she's asked to promote her on-sale ticket date, while Jimmy and Kayla are confronted with a lawsuit.

episodes.title: The Garden
episodes.summary: While Ava pitches her reboot to the network, Deborah does final press ahead of her MSG show and fills a key staffing need at The Diva. Then, Deborah prepares to take the stage for the biggest show of her career – which looks much different than she imagined.

episodes.title: Hacks
episodes.summary: After the greatest show of her career, Deborah takes Ava on an unforgettable trip.
